description: The context view: its row above the prompt, the readings it takes whenever the window moves (the session's start, /clear, a resume or a branch, each turn and request of one, the engine's own figure for a request that consulted the advisor, a compaction, a model switch, a change to auto-compact), a check of the engine's live figures every two seconds, /context-view to hide and show it, and, with the awareness option on, the same figures for Claude as one line after each prompt and after its tool results, from the point the options set; every event it hooks but its own command and the band is passed on unchanged, save that line
